goal: Build So với một người (full synastry): save another person on the device with a name or nickname, relationship type and birth details after the approved consent; compare the user chart with theirs through Sun and Moon element pairs and up to five cross-aspects using the Owner-approved synastry content. Nothing about the other person is sent to AI.
successCriteria: packages/content/data/astrology-synastry.json holds the approved text and validate:data checks its coverage.
The hub has a So với một người row; without a saved own chart it asks the user to create one first.

Adding a person reuses the birth form with name and relationship, shows the consent card before saving, and stores the person only in the device astrology data; people can be deleted and are cleared with birth data.

The comparison shows the intro, Sun and Moon element pairs, up to five closest cross-aspects keeping both a flowing and a tension aspect when present, the footer, no score or summary line; Moon aspects are hidden and the Moon element carries a note when either birth time is not exact; Venus and Mars pairs are hidden for family and work.
No AI entry point or chat handoff includes another person chart.
Mobile check, Jest suite and validate:data pass, and a 390x844 web walkthrough covers add, consent, compare and delete.
untouchedSurfaces: Edge Functions, prompts, AI context builders, entitlements and database.
Account deletion and server sync: other people stay inside the existing device astrology record.
Tarot, Home, Journal and Chat screens.
